title: 2:17 AM
baseline_problem: Camera locks the car into almost one screen pose; suspension and wheel rotation are small at this scale.
repair: Curbside passing three-quarter shot; perceptible travel without overlays; fixed-road landmarks and tire contact.
review_note: Normal-speed preview and HD review: real car/camera travel, tangent-aligned buildings and passing lamps; curb apron corrected.

title: The driver
baseline_problem: Seated arms are articulated, but mirror attention and torso response are underplayed.
repair: Eye lead, head turn to mirror, shoulder follow and return; persistent two-hand wheel grip.
review_note: Reviewed coordinated eyes/head mirror scan and torso response; both palms constrained to steering rim.

title: Something wrong
baseline_problem: Discovery gaze and alley camera direction disagree; braking is mostly environment speed.
repair: Coordinated leftward eye/head/torso attention; braking weight shift; continuous deceleration.
review_note: Reviewed sustained left alley gaze and braking body response; continuous seated articulation.

title: The crime
baseline_problem: Approved V10 dragging. Preserve exact picture.
repair: Preserve source and evaluated frame content.
review_note: All 480 evaluated picture frames across scenes 04–06 match baseline exactly. HD cache bytes match. Actual full master replay inspected. No V10 choreography, proportions, timing or source changes.

title: The trunk

review_note: All 480 evaluated picture frames across scenes 04–06 match baseline exactly. HD cache bytes match. Actual full master replay inspected. No V10 choreography, proportions, timing or source changes.

title: They saw him
baseline_problem: Approved V10 trunk closure/notice. Preserve exact picture.
repair: Preserve latch before turn and evaluated frame content.
review_note: All 480 evaluated picture frames across scenes 04–06 match baseline exactly. HD cache bytes match. Actual full master replay inspected. No V10 choreography, proportions, timing or source changes.

title: Panic
baseline_problem: Shoe deforms across a fixed heel; no explicit foot/ankle segment or pedal-contact solve.
repair: Rigid shoe rotation, ankle attachment, bent leg IK, visible pedal hinge travel and shared throttle.
review_note: Reviewed rigid shoe rotation against hinged pedal, connected bent leg and accelerating driver response.

title: Pursuit
baseline_problem: Chase relies on a large mirror insert; physical closing action is small.
repair: Readable car merge and closing pursuit in exterior coverage, matched mirror and shared trajectories.
review_note: Reviewed actual black-car merge, pursuit travel and depth order; readable exterior before mirror insert.

title: Escape
baseline_problem: Corner steering is brief; low exterior shot crops foreground car.
repair: Show steering anticipation, torso load, outside wheel angle, clear corner path and passing markers.
review_note: Reviewed arm/wheel corner articulation and complete cars in roadside view; road-aligned facades.

title: Safe?
baseline_problem: False safety has little body release or searching attention.
repair: Mirror scan, breath/release, head return while actual car slows and follower is occluded.
review_note: Reviewed mirror check and cautious shoulder/face release while car decelerates through connected street.

title: House 17
baseline_problem: Exit is hidden by parked car and then a running rig appears; door is a loose overlay.
repair: Door pivot, seated-to-standing exit, hand contact, feet find pavement, clear run to porch.
review_note: Reviewed planted exit steps, two-hand door handoff/closure and 5.3 m run; camera leaves feet visible.

title: Locked door
baseline_problem: Close-up arm has no visible owner; key appears only near the lock; little panic acting.
repair: Whole-body/insert continuity; failed pull, panic, pocket search, visible key retrieval and connected placement.
review_note: Reviewed whole-body handle test, pocket key retrieval, insertion/rotation/withdrawal and hinged opening.

title: Inside
baseline_problem: Entry/lock/stairs exist but cuts hide release transitions; stair pelvis uses an eased diagonal path.
repair: Door handoff/release/closure, interior thumbturn grip, planted step-by-step weight transfer and landing.
review_note: Reviewed supported entry, door closure, thumbturn and lever check, hall step and individual stair foot plants.

title: The window
baseline_problem: Character begins at curtain with no approach; cloth response limited.
repair: Walk to window, reach/grip, tensioned folds, pull, look and fear recoil.
review_note: Reviewed U-turn stair landing, upper flight, trailing-foot follow-through and continuous window approach/curtain grip.

title: Unknown call
baseline_problem: Phone starts on inconsistent support; its hand attachment takes over at a threshold.
repair: Visible shared support/phone anchor, vibration, reach/grip/release-from-table, lift, answer.
review_note: Reviewed vibrating resting phone, purposeful reach/grip, continuous chest-to-ear lift and registered palm/device contact.

title: The offer
baseline_problem: Money counter dominates a long restrained pose.
repair: Listening, physical hesitation and shifting shoulder/neck/head responses while phone stays at ear.
review_note: Reviewed visible knee/chest/hand offer reaction, eyes-first window glance and listening holds; phone stays at ear.

title: The warning
baseline_problem: Threat reaction is a small monotonic parameter change.
repair: Anticipation, recoil, breath hold, eye lead to window, head/torso follow, sustained fear.
review_note: Reviewed delayed threat recoil, free-hand reaction and two planted backward steps without camera zoom; phone follows head.

title: The choice
baseline_problem: Choice graphics are animated but not a physical scene.
repair: Preserve exact choice design; review timeline/caption/audio continuity after repairs.
review_note: Reviewed unchanged final choice background and composited A/B layout; all 180 raw background frames pixel-match baseline.
